purpose: Define the deterministic bootstrap sequence from Contract Format to Master to active canonical roots without inferring authority from filesystem placement.

metadata.note: Canonical bootstrap is document/model discovery, not AIGMos runtime startup.

master_role.semantic_role: declares the active canonical roots and top-level canonical entry references

value.discovery_rule: Filesystem traversal provides candidate locations only; semantic activation comes from exact Master membership, allowed source_role and identity/reference validation.
value.filesystem_rule: File presence, path, depth, mtime and scan order are non-authoritative. They may support candidate discovery only.
value.history_rule: Historical, superseded, deprecated, migration or legacy documents may coexist physically but are not active roots unless explicitly represented under their non-active source role.
value.failure_rule: If Master cannot explicitly identify a required active root, record a semantic/source gap instead of scanning the filesystem and guessing.
value.candidate_discovery_rule: After Contract Format and Master are loaded, recursive canonical/json traversal may discover candidate documents. Discovery does not itself make a candidate active.
value.active_membership_rule: Master.active_contract_refs is the explicit active source-membership list. Each listed identity must resolve to exactly one compatible candidate definition.
value.root_rule: Master.active_root_refs identifies semantic/navigation entry surfaces inside the already explicit active source set.

semantics.identity_rule: This member gives an exact owner-scoped identity to the literal Flow token without adding semantics beyond the owning Flow reference field and the preserved source literal.
semantics.interpretation_rule: Consumers may use this identity as an opaque declared Flow symbol. No meaning may be inferred from spelling, whitespace, filename, path or similarity to another symbol.
semantics.authority_rule: A Flow symbol is descriptive/causal model data only and never grants runtime authority, capability, ownership or execution permission.
semantics.scope_rule: Identity is scoped semantically to the defining contract; identical source literals in another contract or another Flow-ref role are not automatically the same semantic identity.

value.purpose: Group deterministic canonical bootstrap and Master discovery semantics.

invariants.rule: Active canonical roots are explicitly declared or referenced by Master.
Filesystem enumeration does not determine active canonical authority.

hard_gates.condition: Master identity or active roots are inferred from conventional filenames or directory paths rather than explicit bootstrap data.
A document becomes an active canonical root solely because it exists in the canonical directory.
More than one active Master resolves for the same bootstrap identity.
Master declares an active root that does not resolve exactly once.
Reader falls back to filesystem scanning or naming heuristics when explicit bootstrap data is incomplete.

references.purpose: Provides the recursive reader that consumes validated active roots.
Master and active roots resolve through explicit canonical identities.
Incomplete bootstrap data is exposed as an explicit gap rather than guessed.

gaps.description: Legacy Topic field operation_refs is preserved in migration evidence; CCF 2.0 does not justify inventing a Link specialization for it.
Legacy Topic field flow_refs is preserved in migration evidence; CCF 2.0 does not justify inventing a Link specialization for it.
